name: Terrain Illusion
description: Makes a whole area of terrain look, sound, and smell like a different kind of terrain.

mechanics.text: While active, an area of terrain appears (to sight, sound, and smell) to be a different kind of terrain than it actually is — the ground's own general shape doesn't change, only how it's perceived. Distinct from feat.creates-illusion (a single discrete object/creature/sound), this covers a whole area at once.
